subject: gk
question: Which of the following is an INCORECT statement related to dental health?

options.text: Tooth enamel, made up of calcium hydroxyapatite is the hardest substance in the body.
Bacteria present in the mouth produce acids by degradation of sugar and food particles remaining in the mouth after eating.
Tooth decay starts when the pH of the mouth is lower than 5.5.
Toothpaste, which is generally acidic, prevents tooth decay.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Toothpaste, which is generally acidic, prevents tooth decay.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Toothpaste is typically** **alkaline** or neutral, not acidic.
 
• Most** commercial toothpastes contain fluoride and other compounds **that help neutralize acids in the mouth, remineralize teeth, and prevent tooth decay.
 
• Acidic t**oothpaste could erode enamel and contribute to dental problems, **
 
 
• **​**whereas a balanced pH is important for maintaining oral health.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Dental health **refers to the overall health of your mouth,** including your teeth, gums, and tongue.
 
• It also includes the ability to perform essential functions like eating, speaking, and breathing without pain or discomfort. 
 
• Dental health is **important for your overall health and well-being. **
 
• **Poor oral hygiene can increase your risk of disease in other areas of your body. **
 
• **For example, poor gum health can worsen blood sugar levels in people with diabetes. **
